public_rationale: CoreWeave's May 21, 2025 announcement identifies senior notes due June 1, 2030 [e1]. It provides original issuance terms, not replacement yields for September 29, 2026 [e1]. Those terms cannot confirm or refute the claimed 11%–13.22% replacement yield range [e1].
limitations: The evidence does not provide September 29, 2026 market observations for the complete relevant unsecured bond basket.
The evidence does not document how secondary-market yields translate into replacement issuance pricing.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If repriced today, CoreWeave's debt would cost 11–13.22% at best.

statement.excerpt: Last year, CoreWeave was already borrowing at ridiculously-high coupons of over 9%, but if that debt was repriced today, it would be paying at the very best rates between 11% and 13.22% — the kind of numbers you’d associate with a personal loan.

from_speaker: if that debt was repriced today
our_interpretation: Assess the conventional fixed-rate unsecured bond basket discussed in the surrounding passage, rather than every form of CoreWeave borrowing.
The ordinary reading is an indicative replacement yield range before an additional new-issue premium.
This is a contemporaneous counterfactual calculation, not a forecast conditional on an actual refinancing.
The statement about last year's coupons supplies background; the screened target is the replacement yield range.
criteria.support_condition: Matching September 29, 2026 Treasury benchmarks and CoreWeave credit spreads reproduce replacement yields spanning approximately 11% to 13.22% for the identified bond basket.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable, same-date and same-instrument observations establish replacement yields materially inconsistent with that range, including comparable issuance below the claimed best-case floor.

evidence.publisher: CoreWeave; SEC exhibit mirrored by Yahoo Finance
evidence.explanation: The announcement identifies a $2 billion issue with a 9.250% coupon, priced at par. This establishes an original instrument, not its September 29, 2026 replacement yield.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Identify the complete bond basket and obtain independently dated September 29, 2026 prices, yields, Treasury benchmarks and credit spreads. Document each instrument's terms, yield definition and conversion to replacement pricing to reproduce or refute the claimed range.
